title: 贝莱德首席：美国就业数据还行经济强劲但招聘平平
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Look, it's maybe two different stories you could paid between an unemployment rate that was less than expected, and jobs, figures, payrolls that missed.
segments.zh: 失业率低于预期，但就业数据不及预期，这可能是两个不同的故事。

segments.en: Which sort of story are you following this morning?
segments.zh: 今早你更关注哪个故事？

segments.en: So listen, I'm more concerned about, you know, last month, you know, people were, you know, tremendously excited about a big jobs number.
segments.zh: 我更关心上个月的情况，当时人们对强劲的就业数据非常兴奋。

segments.en: But if you actually broke it down last month, you have 50, I think it's 54,000 jobs in state and local.
segments.zh: 但如果仔细分析，上个月有5.4万个岗位来自州和地方政府。

segments.en: We didn't really get anything this month. And then you had this huge bump in restaurants in bars, and then obviously that came off significantly.
segments.zh: 这个月没什么新增，而餐馆和酒吧的就业曾大幅增长，现在明显回落。

segments.en: Although I'm surprised it actually came off that much this month.
segments.zh: 不过这个月回落幅度之大让我意外。

segments.en: I thought it would have taken another month or two for that to come off. But listen, I think the hiring in the country is just OK.
segments.zh: 我本以为还会再持续一两个月。但总体而言，美国招聘情况只是还行。

segments.en: I mean, I think it is, I think Mike McKee said it right.
It's stable, it's OK, but you've got an economy that's growing at some pretty significant numbers.
segments.zh: 就业市场稳定、尚可，但经济增长相当强劲。

segments.en: And the employment picture is just OK. I just don't think we are hiring that many people.
segments.zh: 而就业情况只是还行，我不认为我们在大量招聘。

segments.en: I was looking at some of the data earlier in the week. The Challenger job cuts data.
segments.zh: 我本周早些时候看了些数据，挑战者裁员数据。

segments.en: You had layoffs, I think, in tech of 443,000 jobs.
That's up 83% year on year of increased cuts.
So I mean, I think, you know, when you break it down and I look across industries, once again, healthcare is incredible.
segments.zh: 所以，细分行业来看，医疗保健依然强劲。

segments.en: You mean, you look at healthcare and education, 67,000 over the, what was it, 57,000 jobs?
segments.zh: 医疗和教育领域新增6.7万个岗位，对吗？

segments.en: It's all healthcare and education. And so anyway, I think the hiring is, you know, stable.
segments.zh: 全是医疗和教育。所以招聘还算稳定。

segments.en: But, you know, I would say broadly, unimpressive.
segments.zh: 但总体而言，并不令人印象深刻。
